[LGRA.2.9.4] Unknown escape sequences are compile errors. So is a `\x`, `\u`
or `\U` escape that names a codepoint no `String` can hold ([LSTR.1.1]):
U+0000, a surrogate, or a value above U+10FFFF. The compiler must refuse each
as it refuses an unknown escape, and must not emit a string that omits or
substitutes the character.
